guidance.statement: Long-term Fashion EBITDA margin guided to high single digits by FY30 and 10%+ in steady state.
guidance.quote: high single digits by FY '30 and then 10% plus in steady state.

guidance.statement: Beauty stores expected to reach around 600 over the next few years.
guidance.quote: Yes, we have given guidance that we will go to about 600 stores over the next few years.

guidance.statement: Nykaa Now offering expected to expand to 25 cities by end of the year.

achieved.claim: Delivered Q2 GMV of INR 6,151 crores, up 30% YoY.
Net revenue grew 28% YoY to INR 3,006 crores in Q2 FY27.
EBITDA grew 65% YoY to INR 263 crores with an 8.7% margin.
Fashion vertical achieved EBITDA breakeven at INR 1 crore (0.2% margin).

pushback.concern: Ad revenue ceiling and whether ad GMV contribution is approaching a cap.
Whether Fashion EBITDA margin targets can be achieved significantly ahead of FY30.
Negative H1 operating cash flow due to inventory buildup ahead of festive season.
Scaling Nykaa Now against quick commerce competitors expanding rapidly to smaller towns.

output.tone_why: Management highlighted accelerating top-line growth, margin expansion, strong ROCE gains, and profitable scaling in Fashion.
